text.hi: किताब: कविता की खाली जगह भरो।
text.hinglish: Kitaab: kavita ki khaali jagah bharo.
text.en: The book: fill in the blanks to complete the poem.

meaning.hi: जब तेज़ जलता सूरज चला जाता है,
meaning.hinglish: Jab tez jalta sooraj chala jaata hai,

meaning.hi: जब किसी चीज़ पर कुछ नहीं चमकता,
meaning.hinglish: Jab kisi cheez par kuch nahi chamakta,

meaning.hi: तब तुम अपनी छोटी सी रोशनी दिखाते हो,
meaning.hinglish: Tab tum apni chhoti si roshni dikhaate ho,

meaning.hi: तुम्हारी छोटी सी रोशनी के लिए धन्यवाद देता है;
meaning.hinglish: Tumhari chhoti si roshni ke liye dhanyavaad deta hai;

steps.sentence: He could not see which ___ to go,

meaning.hi: उसे दिखता नहीं कि किस रास्ते जाए,
meaning.hinglish: Use dikhta nahi ki kis raaste jaaye,

steps.question: What happens when the sun goes away?

questionMeaning.hi: सूरज के जाने पर क्या होता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Sooraj ke jaane par kya hota hai?

options: The star shows its little light all night.
steps.answer: The star shows its little light all night.
steps.modelAnswer: When the sun goes away, the star shows its little light and twinkles all the night.

modelMeaning.hi: सूरज के जाने पर तारा अपनी छोटी रोशनी दिखाता है और सारी रात टिमटिमाता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Sooraj ke jaane par taara apni chhoti roshni dikhaata hai aur saari raat timtimaata hai.

steps.question: Who does the traveller thank?
steps.modelAnswer: The traveller thanks the little star.

modelMeaning.hi: यात्री छोटे तारे को धन्यवाद देता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Yaatri chhote taare ko dhanyavaad deta hai.

steps.question: Why does he thank it?

questionMeaning.hi: वह उसे धन्यवाद क्यों देता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Woh use dhanyavaad kyon deta hai?

options: Its light shows him which way to go in the dark.
steps.answer: Its light shows him which way to go in the dark.
steps.modelAnswer: He thanks the star because its tiny spark shows him which way to go in the dark.

modelMeaning.hi: वह तारे को धन्यवाद देता है क्योंकि उसकी छोटी रोशनी अँधेरे में रास्ता दिखाती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh taare ko dhanyavaad deta hai kyonki uski chhoti roshni andhere mein raasta dikhaati hai.

steps.question: What lights the traveller?

questionMeaning.hi: यात्री को रोशनी कौन देता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Yaatri ko roshni kaun deta hai?

options: the bright and tiny spark of the star
steps.answer: the bright and tiny spark of the star
steps.modelAnswer: The bright and tiny spark of the star lights the traveller in the dark.

modelMeaning.hi: तारे की चमकीली छोटी रोशनी अँधेरे में यात्री को रास्ता दिखाती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Taare ki chamkeeli chhoti roshni andhere mein yaatri ko raasta dikhaati hai.
